title: Zerobus Ingest into default storage is now generally available
body: Ingesting into tables backed by [default storage](/aws/en/storage/default-storage) with Zerobus Ingest in Lakeflow Connect is now generally available. See [Create or identify the target table](/aws/en/ingestion/zerobus-ingest#create-or-identify-the-target-table).

ref_links.text: Create or identify the target table
